title: Worksheet 3: Strings
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: A string is a data type used to represent text, made up of a sequence of characters such as letters, numbers, symbols, and spaces, all treated as text rather than as numbers a computer can perform math on. In most programming languages, a string is created by placing text inside quotation marks, such as "Hello, world!" or 'Robotics Club', which tells the computer that everything between the quotes should be treated as text rather than as code to run. Even though a string might contain characters that look like numbers, such as the string "42", the computer treats it purely as text unless it is specifically converted into a number first. Strings can be combined, searched, split apart, or measured for their length, and because text is such a common part of computer programs, from displaying messages to processing user input, strings are one of the most frequently used data types in programming.

A whole number with no decimal point

questions.text: According to the paragraph, how does a computer treat the string "42"?
